definitions.explanation: A salary that remains the same each month regardless of performance or hours worked. Contrasted with performance-based or commission-based pay.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}です。
examples.english: This company pays a fixed salary.

examples.japanese: {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}だけでは{生活|せいかつ}が{厳|きび}しい。
examples.english: It's tough to get by on the base salary alone.

examples.japanese: {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}に{加|くわ}えて{業績|ぎょうせき}に{応|おう}じたボーナスが{支給|しきゅう}される。
examples.english: In addition to the fixed salary, bonuses are paid based on performance.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in discussions about compensation structures, job listings, and employment conditions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}+{歩合|ぶあい}{制|せい} (fixed salary plus commission)
- {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}が{高|たか}い／{低|ひく}い (fixed salary is high/low)
- {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}{制|せい} (fixed salary system)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {基本給|きほんきゅう}: base pay — the core pay before allowances; may still vary
- {歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}: commission-based pay — varies with performance or sales
- {年俸|ねんぽう}: annual salary — total pay calculated per year
